title: An idea about inference from incomplete ocean-colour records
query: Drawing on the supplied related work and 2013–2017 MODIS-Aqua data for the South China Sea (104–122°E, 1–25°N), develop and investigate a research idea about what incomplete ocean-colour records reveal about regional chlorophyll variability.

data_scope.limits: The readings discuss daily reconstruction; this reduced task uses independent monthly MODIS inputs for a methodological/seasonal hypothesis, not the shared author target or an exact replication.
